# tenvell

> Open-source React 19 UI kit with thin-glass surfaces, scoped CSS, local Lamina fonts and editable shadcn components.

Official site: https://tenvell.space. Current release: 0.2.1. Code: MIT; original fonts: SIL OFL 1.1. No account or API key required.

Install from the official HTTPS tarball or shadcn registry; do not assume a bare npm name. Import the stylesheet once and use TenvellProvider. The core targets modern CSS @scope/backdrop-filter. Calendar, DataTable, toast and complete product demos are website source examples, not core exports.

## Start here

- [Overview and compatibility](https://tenvell.space/docs/overview.md): product fit, installation choices and limitations.
- [Installation](https://tenvell.space/docs/install.md): exact archive and registry commands, first component, starter and checksums.
- [Integration guide](https://tenvell.space/AGENTS.md): consumer workflow, import boundaries and verification.

- [Working recipes](https://tenvell.space/docs/recipes.md): settings form, controlled dialog and Recharts example.
- [Component inventory](https://tenvell.space/docs/components.json): project-specific JSON with exports, registry items and release artifacts.
- [Complete text reference](https://tenvell.space/llms-full.txt): the full documentation in one request.

## Choose by task

- [Glass interfaces](https://tenvell.space/docs/discovery/react-glassmorphism-ui-kit.md): Build React 19 interfaces with thin-glass cards, forms and dialogs. Four glass surfaces, scoped CSS, local Lamina fonts and MIT-licensed source.
- [Dashboards and settings](https://tenvell.space/docs/discovery/react-dashboard-ui-kit.md): Compose React 19 dashboards and settings screens with tenvell cards, fields, dialogs and optional Recharts shapes. Explore the live product example and API scope.
- [shadcn components](https://tenvell.space/docs/discovery/shadcn-glass-components.md): Add editable React glass components with the shadcn CLI. Start with one button or the complete tenvell UI kit, with scoped CSS and original local fonts.
- [Choose a UI kit](https://tenvell.space/docs/discovery/choosing-a-react-ui-kit.md): Compare the roles of tenvell, shadcn/ui, Material UI and React Aria. Choose a React UI kit by visual style, source ownership, component scope and compatibility.
